data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Sitting at a cozy window seat in a sunset-drenched café, Fiammetta gently cradles a warm coffee cup, looking toward the viewer with a shy, endearing blush and a quiet smile. Golden hour light spills across her face and the wooden table, illuminating floating dust motes and creating a warm, comfortable atmosphere of shared, unspoken warmth.
data.animaCaption: Seated by a sunlit cafe window, she cradles a warm coffee cup in both hands and turns toward the viewer with a shy blush and quiet smile. Golden sunset light spills across the wooden table and floating dust motes.
